_name: Error — validation failed, role=alert line ('Enter an amount greater than zero.')

_signals.error: Enter an amount greater than zero.

_note: Reachable two ways: client-side validation (amount<=0 / no dueDate / new-client missing name → invoicesPage.new.err* strings) or a thrown createInvoice (→ err.message or invoicesPage.new.errCreate). Either sets `error` and leaves the modal open; busy resets to false on the network path so the user can retry.
